title: First workflows, the attempt that never started
tested: The first round trip through an Argo workflow, and a stop while the agent works.
changed: Argo v4.1.5, the workflow template, and the dispatch image went on the orchestrator that morning, with the host rule that lets dispatch pods reach the worker.
setup: Argo v4.1.5, the `investigate` template: dispatch, then the token's revoke
The fixture question, 600 seconds and 6 turns
source: Live system, 2026-10-21 14:12 to 15:00 UTC. `argo get` and `argo list` as the script printed them. Argo has deleted both workflows.

jobs.note: After a Ctrl-C the script went on and submitted the stop step's workflow, which waited for the lock and was stopped there. No job reached the worker.

jobs.message: Pod was active on the node longer than the specified deadline

steps.message: Pod was active on the node longer than the specified deadline

jobs.note: No pod started: the executor's token secret was missing, so the pods waited ([troubleshooting 14](../troubleshooting/14-workflow-pods-wait-for-the-executors-token.md)). The workflow failed at its deadline.
